column1: # ESP32-S3 4 MiB family: dual OTA slots in the T-QT Pro's 4 MiB of embedded
# flash (scheme s3-4m-ota). Each application slot is 0x1F0000 (2
# bytes); the final 64 KiB stays unused so both OTA images remain
# erase-sector aligned. No game partitions: neither the Doom WAD nor a game
# store fits beside two application slots in 4 MiB.
